metadata.datasource:
Prepared for Negs from the manufacturer's datasheet: FUJIFILM ETERNA Vivid 250D brochure, Ref. No. KB-1009E, (c) 2010 FUJIFILM Corporation, page 1 (spectral sensitivity, characteristic curves, minimum and midscale-neutral spectral density; RMS granularity 3.5). PDF sha256 54394f704d56f13864e2dec3ab4b39a627b4844cd0b0148600af6dc43f3828af. Data (c) FUJIFILM Corporation. The curves were read from the PDF's vector paths (tools/film_profiles/extract_pdf.py); the points and axis calibration are in data/profile-sources/fujifilm-cine/fujifilm_eterna_vivid_250d/.
Method: spektrafilm's public-era profile creator by Andrea Volpato (commit b2c7fe6), steps 1-8: D-min removed, log E zero where green is 0.2 over D-min plus 3 stops, dye spectra reconstructed (dmid_dmin) from spektrafilm's generic_a dye set (Giorgianni, Madden & Kriss 2009, p. 112, via spektrafilm) because the datasheet gives no per-dye spectra, status-M unmixing, a 3 norm_cdfs curve fit, sensitivity balance, midscale alignment 'green' (of none/green/mid, the lowest grey-ramp neutrality error, none 0.113, green 0.111, mid 0.134, among those whose kodak_2383 neutral filters fall in the shipped films' range; outside it: 'none'), densitometer normalisation. Then Negs's steps: sensitivity scaled so an 18.4 % grey gives raw exposure 1 per channel under the reference illuminant, and spektrafilm's grey-ramp refinement run on spektrafilm 28bf883 through kodak_2383 at data_trustability 0.3. hanatos2025 adaptation window [399.3, 21.9, 614.5, 59.9] fitted on the reflectance corpus (Otsu (https://github.com/enneract/otsu2018), Munsell (https://zenodo.org/records/3269912), human skin (https://www.nist.gov/programs-projects/reflectance-measurements-human-skin), forest colors (https://zenodo.org/records/3269920)) with a weak prior toward the median of spektrafilm's stored windows. Tools and procedure: tools/film_profiles, docs/adding-film-stocks.md.
Negs choices: reference illuminant D55 (daylight stock, exposed at 5400 K); viewing illuminant D50; target print kodak_2383; log_sensitivity_density_over_min 0.4 as printed; spectra left empty (null) outside the published wavelength range; characteristic curves converted from stops (log10 H = 0.30103 x stops); use 'cine' and antihalation 'strong' as the Vision3 and Eterna profiles.
Note: the brochure caption's '5400K tungsten' is a typo for daylight: D55 (docs/adding-film-stocks.md E)
Recorded validation exception: the reconstructed dyes reproduce D-mid minus D-min within 0.050 D (worst at 405 nm, the chart's blue edge), over the 0.03 D criterion; the §D3 flat extension made it worse. Weighted per kodak_2383 print channel the residual is R/G/B +0.0050, -0.0077, +0.0029 D, within the 0.01 D the method accepts for this case (approved by Noah 2026-11-14).
Recorded extraction exceptions: spectral_density x axis, gate 0.4 % of span: hand-drafted chart: its 500/600 nm gridlines sit unevenly against the 400/700 nm frame, so no straight line reproduces them (worst 0.33 % of span, ~1.0 nm). Physical check: this chart is the same dye curve as Eterna 250D's (KB-0507ER, passes at 0.003 %); with this least-squares grid+frame fit every extremum lands +0.36-0.40 nm from 250D's. Exception approved by Noah 2026-11-14.
